record.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent PNG calligraphic title glyph for an elegant black-and-white Chinese ink-painting Tai Chi game landing page.
Primary request: create an original large Chinese brush calligraphy artwork of exactly ONE Traditional Chinese character, "氣". The character must be correctly written and clearly recognizable: upper radical 气 and lower 米, traditional 氣, NOT the simplified 气. The rice component 米 must be legible.
Style/medium: masterful bold semi-cursive Chinese calligraphy with deep charcoal-black ink, powerful broad brush strokes alternating with fine tapered strokes, visible dry-brush streaks and flying-white texture, organic rough ink edges, energetic confident hand movement. Free and expressive yet structurally readable. A sculptural central glyph that can stand as the main title artwork.
Composition/framing: square canvas; single character centered occupying about 84% of the square, around 8% transparent margin on each side, all strokes fully visible and unclipped. No enclosing circle or giant surrounding arcs. No other objects.
Text (verbatim): "氣"
Color palette: black and dark charcoal ink only, with natural semitransparent dry ink edge detail.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with alpha channel. No paper, no colored canvas, no solid white background, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: only the character 氣, no additional characters, no English, no seal, no stamp, no watermark, no border, no surrounding ornamental strokes. Preserve correct traditional Chinese character construction.
